create_CombinedIndex: create a CombinedIndex that combines multiple FAISS inverted list files into a single searchable index
search_CombinedIndex: search the combined FAISS index with query vectors and return top-k nearest neighbor results
run_CombinedIndexDeep1B: run a CombinedIndexDeep1B benchmark that loads 50 index slices and searches the Deep1B dataset
transform_and_assign_CombinedIndex: transform query vectors and assign them to IVF clusters using the index quantizer
read_fvecs_file: read a FAISS fvecs binary file and return a numpy array of float32 vectors
